name: Globex EMA stack follow, pullback to 5-min EMA20, max 3/day
why: Overnight NQ is thin and driven by slow flows (Asia/Europe index hedging, futures roll of global books) that keep pushing one way for hours; EMA-stack trend-followers and CTAs add on each pullback, and thin overnight liquidity means faders get run over. Pre-registered 2026-10-19 (research/preregistered/2026-10-19_globex_ema_follow.md).

scan.dir: ((ema(tf,9) > ema(tf,20) && ema(tf,20) > ema(tf,50))) - ((ema(tf,9) < ema(tf,20) && ema(tf,20) < ema(tf,50)))
